comments.author: Alrn
comments.body: Another new phenomenon located in Galapagos Island Interior. (You need to get discovery "Lake Darwin" from quest "Mystery deep in the forest" to unlock this inland in Galapagos Island South Coast) I'm not sure about rank of recognition needed, but it's not really high as Blue Fire or Aurora Break-Up. Located right in the Lake Darwin itself (north-west part of the map) in Morning/Afternoon and Clear Sky. Good luck :)
